answer: Sybils are priced out by a refundable bond with a slash window. Each identity key must escrow a stake sized to the real cost of a reserved slot, so a hundred fake keys cost a hundred stakes while a HAVEN of shared rewards stays flat and thins as seats fill. Detection is the second half: every ATLAS of graded work is signed, and fabricated or colluding seats are slashed, burning the bond and delaying withdrawal. If forging an identity costs more than the expected SONNET of honest payouts, marginal profit goes negative and mass registration stops paying.
